headline: I design economies for collectors because I am one.
subheadline: I’m a product strategist who spends my weekends in local game stores, collecting singles, and tracking secondary market velocity. When I saw how broken portfolio liquidity was for real collectors, I didn't write a slide deck, I started building mintwise.cc.

painPoints.title: Collector Psychology & Marketplace Friction
painPoints.desc: I know firsthand why collectors open boxes, chase foils, or dump slabs before market shifts. Most products treat cards as static commodities; BOXED.gg understands that dopamine, transparency, and liquidity drive the real loop. I bring deep domain intuition paired with the analytical rigor to keep game economies balanced and fair.

painPoints.title: Systems Thinking From Strategy to Code
painPoints.desc: My sweet spot is turning complex transactional models into seamless user experiences. Whether whiteboarding complex financial pipelines at StackSource or mapping CSV ingestion and live market pricing data for Mintwise, I work directly alongside engineers to prototype quickly, test unit economics, and ship high-velocity MVPs.
